failure_reason: Kmart returned HTTP 403 on every further category page after ~45 same-origin category fetches from the Chrome tab; stopped at the first block with no retries. 4 emitted leaves (Baby Cots & Mattresses, Baby Highchairs Boosters & Step Stools, Camping Furniture, Bathroom Cabinets & Shelves) therefore carry the site's nav count instead of a page-verified count, and 4 further minor nodes (Bathroom Trolleys, Wall Hooks & Coat Racks, Beach Chairs, and the camping-chairs / camping-tables sub-slugs) could not be inspected at all - all are out-of-scope or sub-5-product nodes. The 27 core Furniture-department leaves are fully verified.
notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome tab only. robots.txt names no Claude agent and is 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with only cart/login/api paths disallowed. The Akamai wall the prior Home-Decor pass hit over the HTTP layer did NOT appear in a real Chrome session - category PLPs render normally. TREE: three independent sources unioned - (1) the homepage mega-menu payload __NEXT_DATA__:props.navigationProps.staticHeaderData (full taxonomy with per-node counts), (2) the category sitemap https://www.kmart.com.au/sitemap/au/category-sitemap.xml (2235 category URLs, keyword-scanned locally for furniture slugs), (3) each category page's own dynamicWayfinders pill strip. The sitemap/second-menu cross-check paid off: Bedside Tables (35) and Wardrobes (2) exist only under the Bedroom department's own 'Bedroom Furniture' menu, not under the Furniture department menu. QTY: for 28 leaves the qty is pageProps.currentCategory.count read from the category page itself via same-origin fetch; that field is what the PLP renders as 'Showing 1-N of N Products' (proved on Bedside Tables: rendered header '1-35 of 35 Products' vs count 35). CORROBORATION: nav count vs page count agreed exactly on 24 of those 28 leaves and differed by exactly 1 on 4 (Bed Frames 1669/1670, Drawers 493/492, Sideboards 279/278, Desks 994/993) - live catalogue drift, not a padded header. That agreement is what licenses using the nav count for the 4 leaves whose page fetch was blocked; those 4 are flagged. BLOCK: after ~45 same-origin category fetches Kmart began returning HTTP 403 on every further category page. Per the hard-block rule I stopped immediately, made no retries and no backoff. Unverified as a result: Baby Cots & Mattresses, Baby Highchairs Boosters & Step Stools, Camping Furniture, Bathroom Cabinets & Shelves (all emitted with nav counts + flags), plus Bathroom Trolleys (nav 3), Wall Hooks & Coat Racks (nav 2), Beach Chairs and the camping-chairs / camping-tables sub-slugs (dropped, see below). TRAP 2 CONFIRMED: /category/home-and-living/rattan-furniture/ returned HTTP 200 but its currentCategory resolved to the PARENT 'Furniture' node (16947) - a bad slug serving a plausible wrong number. Dropped. /category/home-and-living/cabinets/ and /category/home-and-living/outdoor-tables/ are sitemap-only slugs that return 200 with no currentCategory at all and appear nowhere in the nav - not real listing pages, dropped. Every emitted leaf was confirmed to resolve to its own node (currentCategory.url == the URL requested). DEDUP: Kmart re-links the same URL from several menus with different internal group_ids and different nav counts for the SAME url (e.g. /bedroom-furniture/ reads 5883 in the Furniture menu and 2927 in the Bedroom menu; the page itself says 5882). Every node is emitted once, keyed on URL, under its most natural parent: Side Tables / Bookshelves / Shelving Units / Lounge Chairs each appear in two or three of the Furniture sub-menus and are emitted once only. EXCLUDED and why: Bed Mattresses (1168, bedding); Rugs under Hallway Furniture (3799, textiles); Wall Hooks & Coat Racks (2, wall hooks); Bathroom Trolleys (3), Kitchen Trolley (33), Wardrobe/Drawer Organisers, Storage Boxes/Tubs/Bags (standalone storage, Storage task); Wall & Floating Shelves (Wall Decor); Outdoor Cushions, Sun Shelters & Umbrellas, Pots & Planters, Outdoor Decor (not furniture); Beach Chairs, Home Gyms & Benches, Pool Table, Table Games (sporting goods); Table Lamps / Bedside Table Lamps / Desk Lighting (lighting); Tableware, Cake Stands, Tablecloths, Table Runners (dining/textiles); Doll Houses & Furniture (toys); all 'Shop All', 'Latest Arrivals', 'Online Exclusives', 'Clearance' and 'Shop by Collection' nodes (nav junk per rule 3). COMPOSITION CAVEAT carried over from the prior pass and still true: a large share of the inventory under these URLs is third-party marketplace stock (Advwin, Ausway, Costway, VidaXL and similar) rather than Kmart's own range - the counts are exactly what the site reports for the category, but they are not a count of Kmart-branded furniture.
